description: **`ctl.py scene` stages the row's save** (`harness/ctl.py`): a scenario row that names a save has it copied into the game's save folder under a harness name before the launch and cleared after, so campaign rows past the start can join the acceptance order Why: napoleon J46 could not build its mid and late campaign rows: one end turn takes 127 s, so a save cannot be generated by ending turns, and nothing stages a supplied save (test rows: the two saves asked of Liam) Raised: napoleon J46 report, 2026-11-03
title: `ctl.py scene` stages the row's save
